terms.latin: pars media, partis mediae f. mālī, in quā sēmina sunt
terms.gloss: the middle part of an apple containing the seeds
terms.comment: Our description for its core, not a claim that cor is the standard kitchen term. The apple-core description and specific kitchen uses are composed for clarity.

phrases.latin: Partem mediam mālī cum sēminibus exime.
phrases.english: Remove the middle of the apple with the seeds; core the apple.

sources: The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
